title: デビュー戦の後に・倒したいアイツ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon has a magnificent debut race and is practically overflowing with motivation after it ends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a rival that she's hoping to compete with at a big event, and that person is none other than her peer Narita Brian, the current favorite for the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is raring to climb to new heights in order to make her dream come true. We decide to make the junior G1 Hanshin J.F. our next stop!
